scale_note: Urothelial teaching block: 1 unit = 0.5 mm (block 1 mm wide). Deeper lamina propria, detrusor and coverings are compressed; membrane and vesicle thicknesses are enlarged for teaching. The block is not a calibrated full-thickness bladder biopsy. Lateral cell dimensions are enlarged schematically, counts are representative, and umbrella nuclear lateral dimensions are enlarged 2.6x. The nominal ruler conversion is not valid for membrane, vesicle, nuclear or full-wall thickness measurements.

z.meaning: in-plane specimen width/depth; not anatomical anterior/posterior

coordinate_convention.camera: Native Y-up coordinates. Camera yaw zero lies on +Z and looks toward -Z. Sidecar position/target are untransformed model coordinates. No anatomical left/right/front/back claim.

01 · Wall overview.note: Negative X: empty exemplar. Positive X: filling exemplar. This is a static side-by-side teaching comparison, not successive frames of a simulated bladder. Bulk tissue opacity starts at the native 50% default; show 100% briefly to inspect assembled tissue.

02 · Luminal barrier.note: The plaque-covered apical membrane belongs to the umbrella cells. Continuous cell borders must remain readable; no gap is to be explained away by this preset.

03 · Epithelial section.note: Compare thicker domed negative-X urothelium with thinner flatter positive-X urothelium. The cut is an explanatory removal. Removing intermediate cells is a visibility exercise and must not imply an actual gap between basal and umbrella layers.

04 · Umbrella cell contents.note: A close section must expose a recognizable umbrella cell with its nucleus or pair of nuclei and subapical vesicles. This source-derived focus does not establish which owner is intersected; move the display plane or frame a validated owner during separate-machine review.

05 · Suburothelial supply and drainage.note: Lamina propria and muscle are hidden to reveal the represented vessels. Red-to-blue is arterial-to-venous position, not measured oxygen saturation. A followable deep-to-superficial continuation must come from the refined source; the preset supplies no missing geometry.

06 · Muscularis mucosae and detrusor.note: Muscularis mucosae lies in the lamina propria, above the substantial detrusor. Detrusor names group predominant bundle directions; they do not establish three uniformly separable coats across the whole bladder.

07 · Innervation and support.note: Use the native tissue-opacity control for adventitial context. The nerves are representative courses; visible ganglia must become recognizable through refined source detail. No active transmitter release or afferent measurement is encoded by this static view.

08 · Subserosal support exposed.note: Serosa is hidden as an explanatory removal to expose subserosal/adventitial connective support, fat and vessels in the same dome teaching exemplar. Hiding serosa does not turn this specimen into a non-peritoneal wall sample.

09 · Outer wall: dome context.note: Dome teaching exemplar shows serosa on its outer face. The rectangular block has no whole-bladder regional map; a separate non-metric comparative locator may show dome versus sidewall. Model X remains the empty/filling comparison axis.

functional_caption_correction.text: Filling includes regulated exocytosis of subapical discoidal/fusiform vesicles. Voiding-associated compensatory endocytosis recovers apical membrane; the cited experimental pathway delivers internalized membrane to lysosomes rather than simply recapturing it into the same fusiform-vesicle pool. This block depicts no vesicle trafficking over time.
functional_caption_correction.scope: Opened primary-study abstract. Detailed pathways are conveyed by captions/storyboard rather than new organelles in the 23-part mesh.
